verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Secureframe offering a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of its core product. The evidence describes a vendor-hosted SaaS reached through its web app, REST API (api.secureframe.com) and an MCP server that accesses Secureframe-hosted data; none of these amounts to running the core platform yourself.
